description: Расширенные игровые механики с интеграцией всех систем

experience_sources.usage_based: Automatic XP for successful skill use (+0.5-2 XP)
experience_sources.training_based: Formal training sessions (+5-10 XP per session)
experience_sources.study_based: Learning from books/databases (+3-5 XP per session)
experience_sources.mentorship: Learning from NPC mentors (x2 XP multiplier)

skill_degradation.unused_skills: Skills 5+ lose 1 XP per 6 months without use
skill_degradation.reactivation: Lost skills regain faster than initial learning

specialization_mechanics.equipment_synergy: Specializations provide bonuses with related equipment
specialization_mechanics.progression_paths: Advanced specialization options unlock at higher tiers

finding_mentors.npc_integration: Uses NPC_ARCHETYPES to identify potential mentors
finding_mentors.skill_requirements: Mentors must have skill levels 3+ above student
finding_mentors.relationship_building: Reputation and personal relationships affect mentor availability
finding_mentors.faction_connections: Faction standing provides access to specialized mentors

mentorship_benefits.learning_speed: x2 XP gain for mentored skills
mentorship_benefits.advanced_techniques: Access to rare perks and abilities

mentorship_costs.financial_payment: Most mentors charge for advanced training
mentorship_costs.favor_obligations: Mentors may request assistance with personal projects
mentorship_costs.loyalty_expectations: Some mentors expect long-term professional loyalty

space_travel_integration.time_calculation: Automatic calculation based on distance and vessel speed
space_travel_integration.travel_activities: Skill training, research, and social interaction during travel
space_travel_integration.random_encounters: Probability based on route danger and travel time

stress_sources.isolation: +1 stress per week of extended solitude

stress_effects.low_stress_0_25: No mechanical effects, minor RP flavor
stress_effects.moderate_stress_26_50: -1 to all skill rolls, anxiety symptoms
stress_effects.high_stress_51_75: -2 to all skill rolls, panic attacks possible
stress_effects.extreme_stress_76_100: -3 to all skill rolls, breakdown risk

therapy_integration.treatment_options: Multiple therapy types with different costs and effectiveness
therapy_integration.recovery_mechanics: Stress reduction based on therapy type and duration

environmental_hazards.micro_gravity: Affects combat, movement, and skill use
environmental_hazards.atmospheric_differences: Various breathing apparatus and adaptation needs

space_combat.personal_combat_in_space: Modified combat rules for zero-g environment
space_combat.life_support_considerations: Suit integrity becomes critical tactical factor
space_combat.emergency_procedures: Rapid decompression, suit failure, medical emergency

space_exploration.discovery_mechanics: Random generation of resources, anomalies, dangers
space_exploration.first_contact_protocols: Procedures for encountering unknown life or intelligence

reputation_effects.access_levels: Faction standing determines available services and information
reputation_effects.pricing_modifications: Reputation affects costs of goods and services
reputation_effects.exclusive_opportunities: High reputation unlocks special missions and equipment
reputation_effects.hostility_consequences: Negative reputation creates obstacles and dangers

influence_projection.tier_based_influence: Higher player tier allows greater faction influence
influence_projection.decision_participation: Ability to influence faction policies and actions
influence_projection.resource_access: Faction resources become available for player use
